integrity: All local algebra and global characteristic statements are supplied by the proof; a separate finite-field checker provides supporting finite tests. Bibliographic originality remains subject to independent assessment.
scientific_limitations: Classifies only the fixed integral power-sum model; dimensions jump at 2 and 3. Neither stable reduction of the abstract curve nor models with other integral coordinates are addressed. Ordinary p>=7 smoothness is prior literature. The F5-rational point count at p=5 also follows from earlier Redei-related work; new arithmetic information is the full extension-field count from an exact reduced scheme.
title: The small-characteristic fibers of the canonical Bring power-sum model
